feeds.title: A Collected Man Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to The Journal, dedicated to rare, vintage, and contemporary watches. Enjoy its curated selection of articles on the pleasures of fine watch ownership. Founded in 2014, A Collected Man is the leading online platform for discovering, buying, and selling the world's most exceptional watches. We combine a high level of curation with genuine and thoughtful content, in one of the most promising second-hand markets.

feeds.title: WATCHESTV
feeds.description: Created in 2011 and based in Geneva, Switzerland, we have published more than 1'500 original video reports. We're totally passionate about watchmaking and want to take you along with our behind-the-scene videos of this great industry. From product launches to unveiling the many crafts behind your favorite timepiece, we want to be as inclusive as possible and share with you the privileged access we have to brands, suppliers and anything that has got to do with watches.

feeds.title: K&H Watchmaking Competence Centre
feeds.description: School Blog of K&H, a watchmaking school based in Le Locle, Switzerland. Read and learn from the experts on how to build the most top-notch watch.

feeds.title: Garrick Watchmakers Blog
feeds.description: Born out of a desire to create fine timepieces with a distinctly British character, British watch brand Garrick, produce watches infused with high-quality finishing and delightful details designed to appeal to the cognoscenti. Founded by David Brailsford and Simon Michlmayr, Garrick creates fine British timepieces in its own dedicated facility in Norfolk.

feeds.title: Nicholas Hacko Watchmaker
feeds.description: Nicholas Hacko is a watchmaker and dealer from Sydney, Australia. He shares his experience and expertise as a watchmaker through his blog posts.

feeds.title: O.N. Atelier
feeds.description: My name is Olivier, and I am a qualified watchmaker, fully accredited by the British Horological Institute. I work as an independent watchmaker, carrying out service, restoration, and repair work - typically full movement servicing. I hope you enjoy reading the articles on my blog. I enjoy writing these articles and sharing my love of watches.

feeds.title: Michlmayr Watchmakers Blog
feeds.description: Take a look at all the latest horological news and advice from leading UK watchmaker S Michlmayr & Co Ltd.For over 30 years, S Michlmayr & Company Ltd has specialized in the preservation and restoration of timepieces, from the finest quality precision watch repairs to the manufacture and maintenance of some of the largest clocks in the country.

feeds.title: No BS Watchmaker Blog
feeds.description: Straight, raw, and unfiltered tips on watches, watchmaking, and the watch industry. Anthony covers topics like How to Get Into Watchmaking, Tips on Watches, and Behind the Scenes info on the Watch Industry.

feeds.title: Watch Guy
feeds.description: Christian Dannemann has been working as a professional watchmaker since January 2012, and has been a member of The British Watch & Clock Makers' Guild since April 2015. The blog shows his attempts and failures at fixing and servicing watches.

feeds.title: Mark Livak Expert Watchmaker & Restoration Blog
feeds.description: I'm Mark. Watches have been my life for all my life. Apprenticed from age 16 until now 35 years later watches have been my pursuit and passion. I'm an expert watch repairer, giving you full watch services. I buy and sell watches, and restoration such as broken movement, replace crystal, refinish dial, bands & straps, and more.

feeds.title: Village Watch Center Blog
feeds.description: Read all and everything about a watch and clock repair from the Village Watch Center Blog. We have 30+ years of certified experience in all watch repairs and clock repairs. Not only watch service but we do clock repairs, pocket watch repair, jewelry repair, watch band repair, cuckoo clock repair, antique clock repairs, watch battery replacements, and more.
